Usage: memoriahub deploy [options] [command]

Check, install and update this application on a server

Options:
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  doctor [options]     Check that this server meets the prerequisites
  install [options]    Install this application on this server
  update [options]     Bring this server up to the latest revision
  status [options]     Report whether the deployment on this server is healthy
  list [options]       List every deployment on this server
  about [options]      Show what this server says it is running
  certs [options]      Inspect or renew this deployment's TLS certificate
  uninstall [options]  Remove a deployment from this server
  help [command]       display help for command
